hooks.name: astro-check-on-save
hooks.description: Runs astro check after writing .astro/.ts/.tsx files to catch TypeScript errors early (including TinaCMS Collection annotation gotcha).

hooks.name: tina-annotation-reminder
hooks.description: Reminds about required TypeScript annotation and unique field names when editing Tina config files.
hooks.prompt:
A Tina config file was just written. Before continuing, confirm:
1. Every exported Collection/Template object has an explicit type annotation: `import type { Collection } from 'tinacms'; export const x: Collection = {...}`. Without this, astro check fails with a misleading error.
2. Any new field name is unique across all templates in the same collection (different type on same name = GraphQL conflict). Run: `grep -rn "name: '<fieldname>'" tina/blocks/`
3. No hyphens in collection `name` property (alphanumeric/underscore only).

hooks.name: astro-component-checklist
hooks.description: Runs the quality checklist after writing Astro component files.
hooks.prompt:
An Astro component was just written. Verify these rules from astro-standards.md before marking done:
- No `set:html` on unsanitized Tina content (use TinaMarkdown renderer)
- No scattered inline `style="..."` attributes for repeated values
- Interactive elements use `<a href>` or `<button>`, never `<div onClick>`
- Images use `<Image>`/`<Picture>` from `astro:assets` with required `alt`
- Props declared with `interface Props`, no untyped Astro.props, no `any`
- Toggleable element CSS: `.selector:not([hidden]) { display: flex }` NOT `.selector { display: flex }` (otherwise JS `el.hidden = true` won't work)
- If using motion.ts for animation: ensure cleanup of inline style.transform/style.opacity after animation finishes
- If block has per-element scroll animation: add its typename to the exclusion list in BlockItem.astro
